title: Chatbot stress-management for students
summary: The current study investigates the effectiveness of smartphone-based coaching with a chatbot (MISHA) on students' stress levels. Participants are randomly divided into two groups. Various audio tracks with guided relaxation exercises are available for a maximum of 54 days. The chatbot's interactive communication with the participants is intended to strengthen the students' self-efficacy and encourage them to practise the relaxation exercises regularly.

interventions.name: A 4 to 7-week smartphone-based coaching program with interactive psychoeducation on dealing with stress via chatbot and instructions on how to practise mindfulness and relaxation exercises
A 4 to 7-week digital coaching programme with instructions on how to practise mindfulness and relaxation exercises

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
German-speaking students of any gender who are at least 18 years old and have a good knowledge of German are admitted to the study
Exclusion criteria:
none
